limitations: Exact frame spectrum is for counting-measure path-to-minimal-cycle completion; it is not an arbitrary-graph embedding theorem.

Exact CG iteration count assumes exact arithmetic and a zero start, not a fixed numerical tolerance.
Classical Toeplitz/path spectra and prior oblique-dual frame theory underpin the proof; unnoticed equivalent combined formulations may exist.
